title: Indian-Style Potato Pancake
description: A delicious and crispy Indian-inspired pancake recipe made with potatoes and a blend of spices. Serve hot with your favorite chutney or raita.

ingredients.name: pancake spices
ingredients.notes: blend of cumin, coriander, and chili powder

instructions: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Add the grated potatoes and cook until they are lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the flour, ghee, and spices to the potatoes and mix well.
Using a spatula, shape the mixture into a flat pancake.
Cook for another 3-4 minutes or until the pancake is golden brown and crispy.
Flip the pancake and cook for another 3-4 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
Serve hot with your favorite chutney or raita.
